"use client"
// PROBE — compliant control for tests/unit/dynamic-page-params-awaited.test.ts.
// A client page gets a synchronous object from useParams(); `params.slug` is
// a local binding, not the server props Promise.
import { useParams } from "next/navigation"

export default function ProbePage() {
    const params = useParams()
    const slug = params.slug as string
    return <div>{slug}</div>
}
